ui.chat.run_details.jobs.role: section label of the run panel's background-jobs list
ui.chat.run_details.jobs.tone: noun, sentence case, no trailing punctuation
ui.chat.run_details.jobs.note: Labels the panel section that lists running shell and eval jobs. The composer's jobs chip counts the same rows, so this word is the list's only name and must match how that chip speaks of them.

ui.chat.run_details.keep.role: safe-choice button in the background-job cancel confirmation
ui.chat.run_details.keep.tone: single verb, sentence case, no trailing punctuation
ui.chat.run_details.keep.note: Closes the confirmation without cancelling the job, leaving it running. It takes the card's opening focus, so it must read as the safe choice beside Cancel.

ui.chat.run_details.pane_label: Accessible name of the run-details pane element.
ui.chat.run_details.title: Heading of the run-details pane and the crumb back to it.
ui.chat.run_details.subagent_path_label: Accessible name of the breadcrumb navigation through subagent readers.
ui.chat.run_details.previous_subagent: Tooltip and accessible name of the control that opens the previous subagent.
ui.chat.run_details.next_subagent: Tooltip and accessible name of the control that opens the next subagent.
ui.chat.run_details.close_label: Tooltip and accessible name of the control that closes the run-details pane.
ui.chat.run_details.children_unopenable: Notice shown when the backend cannot open a subagent transcript.
ui.chat.run_details.updating_backend: Button label while the backend update is running.
ui.chat.run_details.update_backend: Button that starts the backend update from the run-details pane.
ui.chat.run_details.retry: Button that re-queries backend capabilities after a failed open.
ui.chat.run_details.unopenable: Sentence shown when a subagent transcript could not be opened.
ui.chat.run_details.mcp_auth.title: Dialog title when no conversation is open to sign in from.
ui.chat.run_details.mcp_auth.title_for_s: Dialog title naming the MCP server being signed in to. {server} is a product/server name, kept as the backend supplies it.
ui.chat.run_details.mcp_auth.close: Button that dismisses the MCP sign-in dialog.
ui.chat.run_details.mcp_auth.no_session: Explanation shown when no session is open, so sign-in is unavailable.
ui.chat.run_details.mcp_auth.replace_gra: Primary action re-authorising a server that already has a grant.
ui.chat.run_details.mcp_auth.continue_in: Primary action starting an OAuth sign-in in the browser.
ui.chat.run_details.mcp_auth.try_again: Secondary action that re-runs the sign-in probe after a failure.
ui.chat.run_details.mcp_auth.cancel_sign: Secondary action that cancels the sign-in operation in flight.
ui.chat.run_details.mcp_auth.checking: Progress sentence while the sign-in method is being probed.
ui.chat.run_details.mcp_auth.grant_body: Sentence explaining that a browser window will open for approval.
ui.chat.run_details.mcp_auth.replaces_gr: Appended sentence when re-authorising an existing grant.
ui.chat.run_details.reader.error_shorten: Note under a truncated error payload explaining why the text stops.
ui.chat.run_details.reader.delegated_wit: Section label naming the tools/capabilities a subagent was delegated with.
ui.chat.run_details.reader.read_only_foo: Footer stating that a subagent's transcript cannot be used to steer it.
ui.chat.run_details.reader.no_session_id: Empty state: the subagent has no session id to open.
ui.chat.run_details.reader.no_transcript: Empty state: the subagent's transcript file does not exist yet.
ui.chat.run_details.reader.directory_gon: Empty state: the subagent's session directory is missing.
ui.chat.run_details.reader.loading_conve: Placeholder while the subagent transcript is loading.
ui.chat.run_details.reader.no_conversati: Empty state: the subagent transcript holds no conversation.
ui.chat.run_details.reader.failed: Label above the subagent's own error text.
ui.chat.run_details.subagents_of: Section label naming the parent whose subagents are listed.
ui.chat.run_details.subagents.title: Heading of the subagents section in the run-details pane.
ui.chat.run_details.mcp.servers: Heading of the MCP servers section in the run-details pane.
ui.chat.run_details.mcp.credential_remov: Quiet note on an MCP row whose stored credential no longer exists.
ui.chat.run_details.mcp.grant.running: Row state while a sign-in waits for the browser to return.
ui.chat.run_details.mcp.grant.failed: Row state after a failed sign-in.
ui.chat.run_details.mcp.grant.cancelled: Row state after a cancelled sign-in.
ui.chat.run_details.mcp.refused: Sentence for a sign-in the backend refused, with no attributed cause.
ui.chat.run_details.mcp.credentials_in_s: Where a server that cannot do a browser sign-in keeps its credentials.
ui.chat.run_details.monitors.title: Heading of the monitors section.
ui.chat.run_details.monitors.cancelled: State of a monitor whose cancel succeeded.
ui.chat.run_details.monitors.cancel_refu: Quiet state of a monitor whose cancel was refused.
ui.chat.run_details.todos.title: Heading of the to-do plan section.
ui.chat.run_details.todos.dropped: Inline tag on a dropped to-do item.
ui.chat.run_details.todos.blocked: Inline tag on a blocked to-do item with no stated reason.
ui.chat.run_details.todos.blocked_reason: Inline tag on a blocked to-do item, followed by its reason.
ui.chat.run_details.todos.hidden: Note on a to-do phase whose remaining items are folded away; {count} is a row count.
ui.chat.run_details.wakes.title: Heading of the wakes section.
ui.chat.run_details.wake.cancelled: State of a wake whose cancel succeeded.
ui.chat.run_details.wake.cancelling: State while a wake cancel is in flight.
ui.chat.run_details.wake.cancel_wake: Accessible name for the control that cancels a wake with no distinguishing text.
ui.chat.run_details.wake.cancel_wake_nam: Accessible name for cancelling a wake, naming the start of its prompt.
ui.chat.run_details.wake.cancel_wake_due: Accessible name for cancelling a wake, naming when it fires.
ui.chat.run_details.wake_cancel.keep: Keeps the wake; the safe action in the cancel confirmation.
ui.chat.run_details.wake_cancel.cancelli: Confirmation button state while the wake cancel is in flight.
ui.chat.run_details.monitor_cancel.title: Title of the dialog confirming a monitor cancellation.
ui.chat.run_details.monitor_cancel.messa: Dialog body naming the monitor that stops; {name} is the user's own monitor name.
ui.chat.run_details.monitor_cancel.confi: Confirm button of the monitor cancellation dialog.
ui.chat.run_details.monitor_cancel.stopp: Confirm button state while the monitor cancel is in flight.
ui.chat.run_details.monitor_cancel.keep: Dismisses the monitor cancellation dialog without cancelling.
ui.chat.run_details.mcp_key.title_key: Dialog title when one credential key is missing; {server} is the MCP server's name.
ui.chat.run_details.mcp_key.title_creden: Dialog title when several credential keys are missing; {server} is the MCP server's name.
ui.chat.run_details.mcp_key.cancel: Dismisses the MCP credential dialog without saving.
ui.chat.run_details.mcp_key.saving: Primary button state while the credentials are written.
ui.chat.run_details.mcp_key.save: Primary button that writes the credentials and reconnects the server.
ui.chat.run_details.mcp_key.saved_note: Explains what saving does and that the same keys may serve other servers.
ui.chat.run_details.mcp_key.replace: Checkbox that overwrites values other servers already use.
ui.chat.run_details.chip.todos_open: Chip tooltip clause stating how many to-do items are open.
ui.chat.run_details.chip.todos_closed: Chip clause when every to-do item was dropped rather than finished.
ui.chat.run_details.chip.todos_resolved: Chip clause when every to-do item is done.
ui.chat.run_details.chip.subagents_faile: Chip tooltip clause counting failed subagents.
ui.chat.run_details.chip.attention: Attention clause with no named subject, e.g. '1 needs attention'.
ui.chat.run_details.chip.mcp_attention: Attention clause naming MCP servers; 'MCP' is the protocol name and stays as is.
ui.chat.run_details.mcp.cold_label: One line for the whole MCP section when no session is running, so nothing was checked.
